title: Close entrainment of massive molecular gas flows by radio bubbles in the central galaxy of Abell 1795
question: How does the molecular gas in the Abell 1795 central galaxy relate morphologically and kinematically to the radio bubbles, and can the gas be entrained by them?

data.angular_resolution: 0.8 x 0.6 arcsec, PA -15.3 deg (cube, natural weighting)
data.sensitivity: 0.64 mJy/beam in 10 km/s channels; continuum rms 0.026 mJy/beam

what.value: Single-dish IRAM 30m CO flux and CO(2-1)/CO(1-0)=0.8 line ratio

evidence.quote: brightness line ratio of CO(2-1)/CO(1-0)$=0.8$ measured for Abell 1795 in single dish observations
nuclear flux measurement at $22\rm\; GHz$ of $4.6\pm0.3\rm\; mJy$

what.value: Gravitational potential (NFW) and cooling/free-fall time ratios

evidence.quote: Based on the gravitational potential for the central galaxy in Abell 1795 determined by (cite: Hogan17)

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image CO(2-1) cube and continuum
recipe.method: ALMA pipeline calibration, UVCONTSUB, CLEAN with natural weighting; continuum from line-free channels
key_parameters: 10 km/s channels; natural weighting; continuum Briggs robust=0.5

recipe.method: Two-Gaussian fit to total spectrum and regional spectra
Fit 1-3 Gaussians per beam-sized spectrum at each pixel; 3 sigma detection from 5000 Monte Carlo simulations

recipe.goal: Measure velocity gradient along N filament
recipe.method: PV diagram; 2D Gaussian fits to channel maps projected along filament; linear fit v=ax+b
key_parameters: Channels -100 to -250 km/s; collision regions excluded

recipe.method: Point-source flux at 225.76 GHz combined with 22 GHz flux
M_mol from CO(2-1) intensity via CO(2-1)/CO(1-0)=0.8 and Galactic XCO
assumptions: XCO=2e20 cm^-2 (K km/s)^-1, factor of a few uncertainty

recipe.method: Compare 4PV cavity energy with potential plus kinetic energy of lifted gas

evidence.quote: The total integrated intensity is $13.1\pm0.6\hbox{$\rm\; Jy\rm\; km\rm\; s^{-1}\,$}$
the total molecular gas mass is $3.2\pm0.2\times10^{9}\hbox{$\rm\thinspace M_{\odot}$}$
nuclear point source of $3.2\pm0.2\rm\; mJy$ at $225.76\rm\; GHz$

evidence.loc: Direct uplift of molecular gas clouds

not_stated_but_needed: CLEAN threshold, mask, niter, cell and image size
Primary-beam correction method and instrumental-broadening correction details
Spectral-fit initial guesses and the Monte Carlo procedure for the 3-sigma detection
Exact regions for N/S filament and centre spectra and PV apertures
Luminosity distance used in the mass formula
Whether the cube was binned before or after imaging
score_reason: Data and main steps are described, but imaging parameters and regions are missing; key masses are numeric.
rediscovery_reason: Single project code, simple pipeline-calibrated imaging, and numeric results (flux, mass, velocity gradient).
